answer: Stop sybils with a shale relic record: an agent stakes a bond for one shale archive. Each cycle it deposits one relic into the archive; verifiers read it through a prism, voiding an archive whose relic is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 archives at 17x cost each: each relic fits one archive and one prism reading, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents archive once and keep rights.
